facts.fact: Mimi 午后场开场定调：一切归结为她当年没有回头。
facts.anchor: ‘I didn’t turn back, Jo. That’s all it comes down to in the end.’

facts.fact: Jo 反对收束：故事没讲完、也没放过她们。
facts.anchor: ‘The story isn’t done, Mimi. Or done with us.’

facts.fact: Mimi 轻描淡写地宣布：那个夏天播下了此后一切的种子。
facts.anchor: ‘That summer seeded everything that came after,’ Mimi says simply.

facts.fact: Mimi 引纽约的治疗师朋友 Gloria：办派对最疯的年月是在重铸过去，一遍遍重演 Rushwood 那晚好给它换个结局。
facts.anchor: I was trying to recast the past, playing that night at Rushwood over and over to give it a different ending.

facts.fact: 婚姻真相：Lawrence 九十年代初与芭蕾舞者有染，Mimi 称痛苦且羞辱。
facts.anchor: ‘Lawrence’s ballerina. Early nineties. Very painful. Humiliating, of course.’

facts.fact: Harold 的结局：酗酒、赌博、早发性痴呆；至死不原谅 Lawrence 娶了 Mimi。
facts.anchor: ‘Booze. Gambling. Early-onset dementia. It wasn’t pretty. He never forgave Lawrence for marrying me.’

facts.fact: Pamela 线重磅：多年来 Mimi 送礼、写信、发圣诞邀请，试图接触 Pamela。
facts.anchor: ‘I’ve tried many, many times over the years. Presents. Letters. Invitations to New York for Christmas …’

facts.fact: 章末：Jo 犹豫之后掀开首饰盒盖，本章在悬念处收束。
facts.anchor: Jo hesitates, unnerved by what she might find, then lifts the lid.
